answer: Here is a specific defense: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its opal recurs, its dawn survives audit, and a walnut from an unlinked peer confirms it.
